scene: Perched atop huge bamboo steamers, you gaze across a rooftop awning.
picture: A flat side-scrolling view atop the tall steamer stack. The broad-shouldered Pacific Islander man in a floral shirt, top knot, sandals, and holding his ukulele stands left of centre. Far left, a robot songbird perches on a neon sign. In the centre, an open basket glows. To the right lies a striped rooftop awning.
shown: A blue robotic songbird perched silently on a neon sign far left.
A steaming basket holding one radiant golden bao bun in the centre.
A striped canvas roof stretching outward along the level roofline to the right.
